CREATE TABLE "public"."supplier" (
  "address" text,
  "city" text,
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "contactName" text,
  "country" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "phone" text,
  "taxId" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
